assets.name: naval-vessels-v1
assets.subject: Four rows, four columns. Each row shows one SAME medieval wooden vessel in four successive animation frames facing southeast, locked hull position: row1 small fishing boat with fisherman casting hauling nets; row2 transport merchant sailing cog with moving sail; row3 wooden fire ship carrying clay incendiary pots with ignition and smoke, no modern bombs; row4 historical sailing whaling boat with crew rowing and harpoon equipment. Four frames subtle working motion per row.

assets.name: aquatic-wildlife-v1
assets.subject: Four rows four columns. Four sequential leap or surfacing animation frames per animal, same scale and centered anchor per row: row1 silver tuna breaching from water with splash; row2 red snapper jumping then reentering water; row3 whale surfacing blowing then diving, whale remains same body size; row4 coastal eagle flying wing down middle up middle. Small detached splash effects only, no ocean backdrop.

No square terrain bases, no rectangular background patches.

assets.name: biome-trees-lifecycle-v1
assets.subject: Four rows four columns. Each row SAME tree and ground anchor in four deliberate woodcutting stages: intact tree, trunk visibly axe notched with woodchips, severed trunk leaning pivoting at stump with exposed cut wood, fallen trunk next to rooted stump with leaves and cut chips. Row1 snowy pine; row2 desert date palm; row3 autumn oak orange foliage; row4 tropical rainforest broadleaf tree with buttress roots. Clear intentional axe cutting rather than natural falling. No workers.
